newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton markets end week subdued.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton markets end week subdued.

text.p: Trading was subdued on most European raw cotton markets for lack of any fundamental new influence on prices.

Rotuine demand was evident for supply for shipment in the summer and early autumn but demand lacked vigour. Most mill buyers were cautious despite signs of a progressive tightening of supply for the next few months, particularly of popular Central Asian styles.
Spinners' behaviour in respect of forward purchasing of new crop cotton for shipment toward the end of this year and into next was also tentative.
